description: Skills suggested for an agent (by the CEO in a team; in a one-assistant workspace they are for the assistant): from the weekly review or on demand. Each row names the skill, the agent, why, and the feedback behind it. `waiting` is how many still need your answer. Approve or decline on the Board with `decide` (same confirm dialog as other cards).

agent.description: an agent id or role key (list_agents); where one assistant does every kind of work, a role key with nothing of its own lists the assistant's

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

status.description: proposed, added, declined, removed, or superseded

name: list_skill_suggestions
title: List skill suggestions
